architecture.candidate_generation: cartesian product of 20 standard amino-acid symbols at the documented sites; exclude visible variants; score without hidden fitness
architecture.dream_status: WARM if any pair state observed else DORMANT
architecture.lightning_score: additive memory + mean(weight*pair_residual for observed pair states)
architecture.pair_residual: visible pair-state mean minus global + shrunk main effects, shrunk by n/(n+median visible pair-state support)
architecture.relative_resonance: abs(2*((rank-0.5)/N)-1) within each position-pair residual distribution
architecture.source: GB1 V3 / cross-assay Memory + pair-residual Relative Resonance semantics
architecture.target_transform: visible-only robust shift if needed, then log1p

controls.ADDITIVE_MEMORY: same visible data, no pair residual
controls.EXTRA_TREES: one-hot single-state ExtraTreesRegressor, 500 trees, min_samples_leaf=2, random_state=161
controls.RIDGE_MAIN_PAIR: one-hot single+pair state RidgeCV fixed alphas 1e-4..1e4, 5-fold deterministic CV
controls.SHUFFLE_LIGHTNING: seed 161 permutation of visible labels, unchanged Lightning

cross_dataset_shareable_gate.rule: At least one clean untouched dataset passes all gates, and the second shows A+D+E without a catastrophic reversal (Lightning <50% of additive mean Top10).

pass_gate_per_dataset.A: Lightning mean Top10 > additive AND random
pass_gate_per_dataset.B: Lightning mean Top10 >= 95% of strongest learned baseline (ridge or ExtraTrees)
pass_gate_per_dataset.C: Lightning mean Top5 >= 95% of strongest learned baseline
pass_gate_per_dataset.D: Shuffle Lightning mean Top10 <= 50% of true Lightning mean Top10
pass_gate_per_dataset.E: >=8/10 Lightning frozen candidates have experimental truth

visible_training_selection.if_less_than_384_available: use 40% of available variants rounded down, minimum 96
visible_training_selection.rule: From distinct available variants, sort by SHA256('LIGHTNING_V6|<dataset>|'+variant) ascending and take first 384. This uses genotype only, never fitness.
